description: This source file implements utility functions for the Stun Simple Client, specifically the creation of the simple client object via the function StunCreateSimpleClient. It includes licensing information, module description, and a single function that delegates object creation to StunScoCreate.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE StunCreateSimpleClient(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Simple Client object by delegating to StunScoCreate, returning its handle.
